Ali pitches it up outside off, Cook strides forward and creams it through covers. Incidentally, the last 100-run stand  for the opening wicket too was stitched by these two. Can they do it again?
Lovely ball from Ali, forces Cook to go for the drive. The ball moves away a bit and the southpaw gets beaten.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Good leave from Cook. Ali pitches it on length, it comes back a bit and Cook watches it go through to the keeper.
Pitched up and Cook drives it for the mid off fielder to collect.
Outside off, no trouble for Jennings as he leaves it alone.
Lands this around off, Jennings plays and misses.

FOUR! STREAKY! Inside edge and away to the fence. Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Jennings plays a chinese cut and the ball goes over the leg pole to the fine leg boundary. The partnership now moves to 47.
Outside off, left alone.
Keaton lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Around off, Jennings looks to play this to the off side but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Wide and outside off, it was there to be hit. Cook cuts it well but finds the man at backward point. Dot ball.
Gets this off the inner half towards mid on.
Fuller this time and around middle and leg, Cook plays it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Misses his line and duly gets punished. Bowls this wide outside off, Cook has enough time to free his arms and cuts it through point for a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Strays this down leg but Cook still goes after it. Does not make any contact.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads. No damage done.
Jeannings drives this through the covers.
Lands this outside off, easier for KJ to leave it alone.

Comes from round the wicket and serves it around leg. Jennings is beaten and the ball strikes his leg. The Pakistan players appeal but the umpire is quick in saying no. They have a chat and opt not to take it up. A good decision as the ball had pitched outside leg.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Beauty to start with. Hurls it on a good length just wide of the off pole. Jennings looks to defend it with a straight bat but gets beaten.
Faheem Asharf is introduced into the attack to bowl from the other end.
Goes for the flick but misses it. The ball rolls to the leg side and they take the leg bye.
Jennings takes a step ahead to defend but gets an inside edge onto this pads.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! A bit short but outside off, Jennings who is well in control cuts it in the gap through backward point for his fourth boundary.
Flicked away by Jennings as Hasan misses his line. Gets it in the gap to deep square leg and they come back for the second run.
Starts of with a good one. Good length ball just outside off, Jennings flirts with it but misses.
First change for Pakistan. Hasan Ali is brought on to bowl.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
In line of the stumps, Cook gets behind the ball and is solid in defense.
Outside off, no need to pay at these.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Makes it look so easy. Third one for Cook. Amir drifts this down leg and Cook flicks it away through mid-wicket. A boundary results.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

FOUR! SHOT! Beautifully played and does not bother running for it. Overpitched from Abbas and Keaton leans ahead and drives it in the gap through covers. This opening partnership has now equaled their best in Tests for the year.
Length ball just outside off, the ball comes back in but is well watched and left by Jennings.
Around off, Jennings pushes this to the off side.
Around off, Jennings covers his stumps and blocks it solidly.
Outside off, left alone.
No swing for Abbas as Jennings leaves it alone outside his off stump.
Alastair shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Outside off, Cook does not bother playing at it.

Just short. Shouldn't have played at that one. Jennings looks to steer this towards the slip cordon. But the ball goes off the edge and falls well short of the third slip fielder. He cannot stop the ball and the batsmen take a run.
Gets forward and drives this towards point.
On that fifth stump channel, Jennings watches the ball as it goes to Sarfraz.
Pitched up ball on off, pushes solidly to covers.
Length ball on off, Cook points his bat skywards to let it through.
Around off, Cook gives it to the man at point.
In line of the stumps, the chef has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length ball on middle and leg, Cook plays this to the mid-wicket fielder.
Outside off, Cook covers his stumps and lets the ball go to the keeper.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Good length ball on off, KJ looks to have a go at it but cannot get any bat to it.
Cuts this towards the point region and jogs to complete the run.

Interesting! Problems of being a bit too tall. Ben Stokes was sitting in the balcony to have a nice view of how his mates are going on with their batting. But his position was just above the sightscreen. As a result, Cook signaled him to bend down in order to not get distracted. He bent down and then peeped to see if the ball had been bowled, to then get up and go inside the dressing room. Tall tales!
PEACH! On that fourth stump channel, forcing Cook to play who gets his blade out but gets beaten.
AC lets this ball go outside his off stump.
Third man in place as a follow-up to the previous boundary.
FOUR! Playing with the field is Cook. Amir hurls this on a good length outside off, Cook opens the bat face and guides it past the fourth slip for another boundary. They are really looking good.
Full and wide outside off, Cook leaves it alone.
FOUR! Elegantly done! A tad full from Abbas and Jennings drives it crisply through cover-point to get his first boundary. A steady start so far from the home team.
Gives this ball to the gully fielder to collect.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
Around off, Jennings closes the bat face early and gets a soft edge towards the off side.
Length ball outside off, Jennings does not offer a shot to this.
Full and outside off, Keaton leaves it alone.
Pushes this to the cover region and gets a single. They are running really well here.
FOUR! Fuller ball outside off, Jennings guides it wide of gully and the ball has enough legs to get get to the rope.
Too far for Jennings to make any contact.

Keaton Jennings was had a word with by the square leg umpire in the previous over. The reason was that he was deemed to be getting close to the danger area on the pitch. The opening batter is standing well outside the crease, due to which, his stride forward comes really close to the danger area. There's more to worry in the game than this for Jennings, says Nasser Hussain on air.
Frustrating for the bowlers here. Runs from the first three balls already. Cook plays this off this back foot towards point and gets another run.
Jennings is up and running. Length ball wide outside off, Jennings opens the face of the bat and guides it far from the gully fielder. The fielder in the deep cuts it out and the batsmen run three.
Length ball on off, Cook taps it to the off side with soft hands and sprints to complete the run. Good running.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full this time outside off, Jennings lets the ball go to the keeper.
Length ball outside off, gets it to move away a bit, Jennings is happy to leave it alone.
Outside off, left alone.
Jennings shoulders arms to let that one through.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.

FOUR! That's the length and Cook gets an edge through the slip cordon. Full and outside off, Cook looks to defend it but gets an outside edge as the ball flies past third slip. So the former skipper gets going with a streaky boundary.
Outside off, hint of away swing and Cook leaves it alone.
PEACH! Excellent from Amir! Makes Cook play at it and almost gets his outside edge. Serves it on a good length around off, Cook plays and misses.
Angles this down leg, Cook works it to mid-wicket for a dot.
Ohh!!! Edged but falls short of the man at second slip. Serves this fuller on off, Cook pokes at it and gets a soft outside edge that lands just short of second slip.
Comes in from over the wicket and bowls it on a good length outside off, Cook shoulders his arms to it.
